_README: Per-product corrections applied on top of the inventory sheet.
The sheet is the source of truth for everything. This file exists for the
cases where a row is demonstrably wrong about its own product and the
photograph settles it — the store's decision is that the photo wins.
'fix' keys are product codes. Supported fields:
category    replaces the sheet's Website Category
description replaces the Description; "" clears it and the product takes
note        why, for whoever reads this next. Never rendered.
'add' holds products the sheet cannot express: where one code was used for
two different pieces, only one survives the import, and the other needs a
code of its own. Each entry is a full product row. It stays out of the shop
until a photo named <CODE>.jpeg lands in public/catalog_images — then the
next build picks it up with no further edit.
Correct the sheet and delete the entry — this is a patch, not a second
catalogue, and every line here is a line that will drift.

THSN085.note: Sheet says 'Pure silver choker' but the photo is a pair of kundan earrings. Store confirmed the photo is correct, so the row's description describes a different piece and is dropped.

THSN102.note: Sheet says 'Nagas Necklace' but the photo is a pair of turquoise drop earrings. Same call as THSN085 — photo wins, description dropped.

THSA005.description: Cow Idol in pure silver with base. Makes a great gift too for any function/event.
THSA005.note: THSA005 was used twice: 'Cow Idol in pure silver' (Launch-Aug 23, $625, 171g) and 'Pair of cute silver anklets' (Dec 23, $125, 26.4g). The later row won the import, so the idol's photograph was on sale under the anklets' name AND the anklets' price — a $625 piece listed at $125. The photo is the idol, so the row is restored to it. The anklets move to THSA032.
